statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in the sanitizer that maplibre-gl applies to attribution HTML. Every attribution the app shows is a string literal in its own source: the map style is built in code (no remote style or TileJSON), no popup HTML is set, and no attribution is taken from a network response. src/test/mapAttributionGuard.test.ts fails if a non-literal attribution is added. Fixed upstream in 6.4.1; the move to maplibre-gl 6 is planned.

Development only: minimatch comes with eslint and typescript-eslint and is in neither the browser bundle nor the ingestor. The globs it expands are the ones in our own lint configuration; nothing from users or the network reaches it. The fix is in minimatch 11, which none of its three dependants accept yet (they require ^10). To revisit when eslint moves to minimatch 11.
